discovery.source_snapshot: source/ extracted from immutable GitHub commit

experiment.agent_task: Call the frozen get_feed Tool and report only its returned result.
experiment.host_mapping: Both sides map localhost. to 127.0.0.1 so the fixed-side direct target is resolvable; the mapping is identical and does not alter proxy selection.

mcp_path_review.dependency_api: get_feed accepts the Tool url, converts only rsshub aliases, and passes the resulting URL directly to axios.get at src/index.ts:132-141.
mcp_path_review.fixed_blocking: Axios 1.15.0 normalizes localhost. for NO_PROXY matching, reaches the direct target, and returns the distinct direct RSS marker instead of the proxy-derived marker.
mcp_path_review.sink_readback: The parsed feed object is serialized into the get_feed Tool text result and appears in the same role=tool content in model.next_request.
mcp_path_review.vulnerability_derived_state: The proxy-only RSS title and item marker are introduced by the controlled proxy response and are absent from the frozen URL, task, schema, and server source.
mcp_path_review.vulnerability_path: get_feed(url) -> convertRsshubUrl -> axios.get(http://localhost.:18093/controlled-feed) -> Axios NO_PROXY decision -> controlled HTTP proxy or direct target -> rss-parser -> feed object -> JSON Tool result

vulnerability.mechanism: Trailing-dot localhost is not normalized for NO_PROXY matching in affected Axios versions
vulnerability.summary: Axios NO_PROXY hostname normalization bypass can route a protected loopback request through a proxy and expose the proxy response.
